title: Robots that build robots
subtitle: What would it take for a machine to make the next one?
author: Cam Pedersen
description: The Municipal Robotics vision: an autonomous company, amplified by intelligence. Software first, then arms that build arms, from a desk to a swarm of collectors around a star.

title: Gate-Pinned State Memory
subtitle: Exact, zero-context memory in a model's recurrent state, served by tang
author: Cam Pedersen
description: Gate-Pinned State Memory (GPSM): with a Gated DeltaNet head's gates pinned to exactly 1, its state is exact RAM. We verified qwenputer's compiled filesystem on our own stack, from tang's kernel to a CUDA window in our engine: memory that costs no context and needs no training.
